changes: Added a control-arm memory ISOLATION layer on top of main B-ab8d: redactMemoryPackForControlArm (new core/runtime-memory-arm-gate.ts) empties the runtime-memory pack at every JSON/file serialization surface on the control arm (done_closure/final_response_check/host_dispatch/handoff/prefetch-manifest/playbook_runtime_health), final_response_check now routes through surfaceRuntimeMemoryPack (the 8th RuntimeConsumer), experienceRefs() returns [] on control, and memory_benchmark_real_data + source_lineage_audit joined the memoryRetrieval markers.
